sampling.cpuDenominator: Actual monotonic interval between /proc/stat reads, including scan/write/parse overhead
sampling.claim: Discrete /proc sampling; not continuous process tracing

measurement.onViolation: Stop only the owned Lighthouse runner; preserve the entire attempt; no selective sample culling

storage.format: Compact JSON; every sample and diagnostic retained; raw Lighthouse reports only in bounded scratch

policy.limits: Only /proc-visible Linux activity is observed; Windows workloads and real-device/field performance are not certified.
